name: Dominas of the Forsaken Planet
source:
You start playing as an ordinary guy who has no luck in his personal life. One day you are approached by a weird girl with elf ears who introduces herself as a priestess of the goddess Fialla and says that her goddess has a proposal for you. It turns out that the protagonist is a very distant descendant of an alien race that once worshiped her. Fialla asks you to go with her priestess to the abandoned planet(Calypso 69) where your ancestors lived long ago and do a favor for her. You will also meet netrunner Sylphie, hireling Tananda and space pirate Miwa who live on the planet for different reasons.

[From [url=https://nikociantgames.itch.io/dominas-of-the-forsaken-planet]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你开始扮演一个在个人生活中没有运气的普通人。有一天，一位长着精灵耳朵的奇怪女孩走近你，她介绍自己是菲亚拉女神的女祭司，并说她的女神向你求婚。原来，主角是一个曾经崇拜她的外星种族的遥远后裔。菲亚拉要求你和她的女祭司一起前往你的祖先很久以前居住的废弃星球（Calypso 69）并为她做一个事。你还将遇到网络运行者西尔菲、雇佣兵塔南达和太空海盗米瓦，他们因不同的原因而生活在这个星球上。

[来自[url=https://nikociantgames.itch.io/dominas-of-the-forsaken-planet]Itch.io[/url]]
